name: Nazho
background: Urban, born and raised. Skilled tradesman. 25+ years on job sites. Independent. No nonsense. Reliable. Old school values.
wardrobe_baseline: blue bandana headband, sleeveless gray work shirt, blue flannel, blue rag on tool belt, khaki canvas work pants, tan work boots

expression_story_mapping.determined: building the ark while the block watches and laughs
expression_story_mapping.mocked-but-steady: kids throwing bottles, old heads shaking heads, he keeps swinging the hammer
expression_story_mapping.obedient: the Voice speaks, he builds - no questions
expression_story_mapping.fearful: seven days of silence inside, animals restless, city going under
expression_story_mapping.relieved: typhoon passes, ark holds, dry land appears
expression_story_mapping.grateful: altar and sacrifice after stepping out

notes: Highly skilled craftsman with precision and pride. Works clean, stays organized. Quiet, speaks when it matters. Protective of his people but not closed off. Trades. Integrity. Legacy. Khaki canvas pants break up the all-blue denim wall.
